# CarouselHub — Tasks & Design Notes

## Recreates

- ColorLib source: `carousel-03` (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-03/`)
- Assigned app name: `carousel-hub` (`@free-react-templates/carousel-hub`)

## Section Structure & Order

1. **Navbar**: Fixed header with brand logo, navigation links (Home, Features, Gallery, Testimonials, Contact), and CTA button.
2. **Hero Carousel**: Full-width interactive image carousel with smooth transitions, slide indicators, and previous/next controls.
3. **Features / Highlights Grid**: 3-column feature cards with Lucide icons, titles, and descriptions.
4. **Interactive Card Slider**: Secondary carousel showcasing item cards.
5. **Newsletter Signup**: Call-to-action banner for updates and subscriptions.
6. **Footer**: Multi-column links, copyright notice, and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Notes

- Preview URL `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/carousel-03/` was unreachable (404); replicated based on official ColorLib screenshot and robust carousel design pattern.
- Uses `https://picsum.photos/seed/carousel-hub-<n>/1200/800` for deterministic placeholder photography.
